title: 第23章 何以为官第24章 敕令嘉奖
content_zh:
清晨的微光透过石屋厚重的窗棂，将静室内弥漫的淡淡尘埃照得纤毫毕现。
苏秦盘膝坐于蒲团之上，周身气息起伏不定。
如同潮汐拍岸，每一次呼吸都伴随着极其细微却绵长的“嗡嗡”声，那是体内元气在经脉中奔涌的轰鸣。
良久，他缓缓睁开双眼。
那一瞬间，静室内仿佛划过了一道冷电，原本有些昏暗的空间竟似亮堂了几分。
眼前那淡蓝色的面板微微颤动，一行数据清晰浮现
【聚元决三层（295300）】
“经过这五天的修炼，只差临门一脚了。”
苏秦感受着丹田中那几乎满溢而出的充盈感，轻轻吐出一口浊气。
这口浊气凝而不散，在身前三尺处化作一道白练，久久才归于虚无。
“聚元三层与四层，虽同属初境，却有着天壤之别。”
他低头看了看自己的手掌，五指微握，便能感觉到空气中游离的水汽正欢呼雀跃地向掌心汇聚。
回想起前几日在苏家村的那场大雨。
若是换做聚元二层时的自己，想要覆盖那几百亩旱地
即便有“枯荣”之法透支潜力，至少也得断断续续耗上半个月，且每次施法后都要像死狗一样躺上半天。
而到了聚元三层，元气不仅在量上翻了倍，更在质上有了飞跃。
它变得更加粘稠，更加“听话”，对法术架构的支撑力也更强。
五天时间，不仅下透了雨，甚至还有余力去精细化操作，完成了法术的进阶。
“三层尚且如此，若是到了四层……”
苏秦眼中闪过一丝向往。

聚元四层，是这门功法的中段分水岭。
据说到了那一层，体内的气态元气将开始产生第一缕“液化”的迹象，那是质变的开始。
一旦元气液化，无论是施法速度还是持久力，都将是倍数级的增长。
“距离二级院的考核，还剩下正正好好三十天。”
苏秦站起身，简单的洗漱一番，看着铜镜中那个神色坚毅的少年，低声自语
“不求在这三十天内追上那些从小便用灵药泡大的世家子，只求聚元决到了中位，不拖后腿，我便有信心晋级二级院。”
整理好衣冠，苏秦推开石门，迎着朝阳，向听雨轩走去。
听雨轩外，骄阳似火。
虽已入秋，但那日头依旧毒辣得如同盛夏，将碧波潭的水位晒得都下降了尺许，露出干裂的岸泥。
水榭四周的垂柳蔫头耷脑，连那知了的叫声都显得有气无力。
唯有轩内，因着那座小型聚灵阵的运转，还勉强维持着几分清凉，但那股子日渐紧绷的焦躁氛围，却比这外头的热浪还要灼人。
距离二级院的大考，只剩下最后三十天。
对于听雨轩内的每一位内舍弟子而言，这三十天，是鱼跃龙门前的最后一次蓄力，是决定未来命运走向的倒计时。
然而，今日的气氛却有些诡异。
众人的目光，总是有意无意地飘向讲台左侧，那个位置最为显赫、铺着深色蒲团的座位。
空的。
这已经是第五天了。
属于那个天之骄女林清寒的位置，已经整整空置了五日。
从最初的迟到，演变到了如今的彻底旷课。
“这也太目中无人了些。”

坐在苏秦斜后方的赵猛压低了声音，粗壮的手指轻轻敲击着案几，语气中满是不忿与酸意
“咱们这些人，哪个不是闻鸡起舞，生怕错过胡教习的一句金玉良言？
她倒好，仗着天赋高，仗着教习偏爱，说不来就不来。
这听雨轩的规矩，难道只约束咱们这些凡夫俗子？”
旁边有人低声附和，眼神复杂
content_en:
The early morning light shines through the thick window lattice of the stone house, illuminating the faint dust that fills the quiet room.
Su Qin sat cross-legged on the futon, the breath around his body fluctuating.
Like the tide crashing on the shore, every breath is accompanied by an extremely subtle but long-lasting "buzzing" sound, which is the roar of the vitality in the body rushing through the meridians.
After a long time, he slowly opened his eyes.
At that moment, a cold lightning seemed to flash across the quiet room, and the originally dark space seemed a bit brighter.
The light blue panel in front of me trembled slightly, and a line of data appeared clearly.
[Juyuanjue third level (295300)]
"After these five days of practice, we are just one step away from the finishing touches."
Su Qin felt the almost overflowing fullness in his Dantian and gently exhaled a breath of turbid air.
This turbid air condensed and refused to disperse. It turned into a white line three feet in front of the body, and it took a long time to return to nothingness.
"Although the third and fourth levels of Juyuan are both in the initial realm, they are completely different."
He looked down at his palm, clasped his fingers slightly, and could feel the water vapor floating in the air gathering happily towards his palm.
Recalling the heavy rain in Sujia Village a few days ago.
If I were myself on the second floor of Juyuan, I would want to cover hundreds of acres of dry land
Even if there is the overdraft potential of the "Ku Rong" method, it will take at least half a month intermittently, and after each spell, you have to lie like a dead dog for half a day.
By the third level of Juyuan, the energy had not only doubled in quantity, but also made a leap in quality.
It becomes more viscous, more "obedient", and has stronger support for the spell structure.
In five days, not only did it rain, but I even had the energy to refine the operation and complete the advancement of the spell.
"This is the case on the third floor. If it reaches the fourth floor..."
A trace of yearning flashed in Su Qin's eyes.
The fourth level of Juyuan is the watershed in the middle of this technique.
It is said that at that level, the gaseous vitality in the body will begin to produce the first signs of "liquefaction", which is the beginning of qualitative change.
Once the vitality is liquefied, both the casting speed and endurance will increase exponentially.
"There are exactly thirty days left before the assessment of the second-level college."
Su Qin stood up, washed himself briefly, looked at the resolute young man in the bronze mirror, and whispered to himself
"I don't want to catch up with those children from aristocratic families who have been soaked in magical elixirs since childhood in these thirty days. I just want to reach the middle level in the Juyuan Jue without holding back. Then I will have the confidence to advance to the second level."
After tidying up his clothes, Su Qin pushed open the stone door, faced the rising sun, and walked towards Tingyuxuan.
Outside Tingyuxuan, the sun is burning like fire.
Although it was already autumn, the sun was still as scorching as midsummer, causing the water level of Bibo Pond to drop by several feet, exposing the dry and cracked mud on the shore.
The weeping willows around the waterside pavilion were drooping, and even the cry of the cicada seemed feeble.
Only inside the pavilion, due to the operation of the small spirit-gathering array, it was still somewhat cool, but the increasingly tense and anxious atmosphere was even more scorching than the heat wave outside.
There are only the last thirty days left before the big exam of the second-level college.
For every inner disciple in Tingyuxuan, these thirty days are the last time to accumulate strength before leaping over the dragon gate, and a countdown to determine the future destiny.
However, the atmosphere today is a bit strange.
Everyone's eyes always drifted to the left side of the podium, intentionally or unintentionally, to the most prominent seat covered with a dark futon.
Empty.
This is already the fifth day.
The seat belonging to Lin Qinghan, the proud daughter of heaven, has been vacant for five days.
From being late at first, it has evolved to being completely absent from class today.
"This is too arrogant."
Zhao Meng, who was sitting behind Su Qinxie, lowered his voice and tapped the table with his thick fingers, his tone full of dissatisfaction and sourness.
“Which of us among us is not dancing at the sound of a chicken, fearing that we will miss one of Hu’s wise words?
She is good, relying on her high talent and relying on her trainingLove, if you say it can’t come, it won’t come.
Does Ting Yuxuan's rules only restrict ordinary people like us? "
Someone next to me whispered in agreement, with complicated eyes.
